for you, Baba. read slowly.

Okay so, hi. I made you a whole thing while you were sleeping. Very normal behavior, I know.

Look, the last two days weren't great. I get it. We didn't get enough time and I know that gets in your head, Baba. But I need you to hear this from me directly: nothing is wrong with us. The quiet wasn't me pulling away. It was just life being annoying.

You're not losing me, Eddy. That's not something you need to worry about. I chose you. I still choose you. Every single day, even the ones where we barely talk.

So please, take a breath. We are so okay. More than okay. And I made you this whole dramatic beautiful website at this hour just so you'd wake up and know that.

The distance is just a chapter. It's not the story. We are the story. And it's nowhere near done.

yours, always. even when it’s quiet. 🤍
